brandPositioningSummary: Residence Inn by Marriott is an owner-facing upscale extended-stay Residence Inn suite brand within Marriott International. Underwrite the asset against this brand's guest promise, product scope, and operating complexity rather than sibling brands or corporate platform averages.
audienceSummary: Residence Inn by Marriott targets guests aligned with Contract / Extended Stay, Bleisure, Leisure. Evaluate demand behavior in each target market rather than generic chain-loyalty averages or parent-platform assumptions.
ownerFitSummary: Residence Inn by Marriott should be chosen when the asset can deliver this positioning more credibly than TownePlace Suites, StudioRes, Element, and Apartments by Marriott Bonvoy. Assess whether demand mix, product scope, and operating complexity favor Residence Inn by Marriott over adjacent Marriott alternatives in the same tier and geography.

valueCreationScenarios.title: Extended-Stay Suite Demand Capture
valueCreationScenarios.summary: Residence Inn fits owners targeting longer-stay and project demand when suite layouts, kitchens, and residential social space match upscale extended-stay expectations rather than short-stay select-service prototypes.

valueCreationScenarios.title: Suburban And Urban Corridor Suites
valueCreationScenarios.summary: Suburban employment nodes and urban extended-stay corridors create Residence Inn value when sponsors underwrite weekly housekeeping models, parking, and suite mix against real length-of-stay patterns.

valueCreationScenarios.title: Conversion Into Upscale Extended Stay
valueCreationScenarios.summary: Capable suite or apartment-style shells can reflag to Residence Inn when PIP delivers residential product quality. Value weakens if the asset is forced into a StudioRes midscale or TownePlace select-service story.

valueCreationScenarios.title: Network Reach For Longer Stays
valueCreationScenarios.summary: Bonvoy reach helps Residence Inn when commercial systems support extended-stay booking patterns. Owners should compare Element and Apartments by Marriott Bonvoy only when the product thesis truly matches those lanes.

scenarios.title: Upscale Extended-Stay Suite Positioning
scenarios.summary: Residence Inn creates owner value when longer-stay guests need suites, kitchens, and a residential stay rhythm—not a transient select-service box. Underwrite suite mix, social space, and operating model to extended-stay reality. Keep StudioRes, TownePlace Suites, Element, and Apartments by Marriott Bonvoy out of this diligence file unless the asset truly matches those products.

scenarios.title: Project And Relocation Demand Nodes
scenarios.summary: Owner value rises near employment, medical, education, and relocation corridors that generate multi-night stays. Diligence competitive suite supply and length-of-stay patterns before modeling affiliation lift. CALA evidence such as Residence Inn Merida helps regional owners see extended-stay product delivery outside US-only comps. Keep Residence Inn by Marriott product and service responsibilities clear among owner, operator, and brand teams so the upscale extended-stay Residence Inn suite brand stays deliverable after affiliation and through ongoing operations.

scenarios.title: Operating Model Discipline After Affiliation
scenarios.summary: Bonvoy and Marriott systems help only when housekeeping, breakfast, and suite maintenance match Residence Inn expectations. Sequence training and PIP so residential product quality survives opening. Avoid copying SpringHill all-suite short-stay logic into Residence Inn underwriting. Keep Residence Inn by Marriott product and service responsibilities clear among owner, operator, and brand teams so the upscale extended-stay Residence Inn suite brand stays deliverable after affiliation and through ongoing operations.
